preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints must be valid vertex indices within the range of 1 to n.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1 for a valid tree.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal time t required for all ants to reach the root.
